profile.businessSummary: Action Construction Equipment Limited is India's leading material handling and construction equipment manufacturer, distinguished by its cutting-edge products and a majority market share in the mobile and tower cranes segment. The company's overarching goal is to establish itself as a globally renowned and sought-after organization by fostering business growth in both Indian and international markets. A commitment to innovation drives its research and development efforts, while its operational flexibility and agility enable it to serve a diverse range of industries effectively. Its diverse portfolio includes hydraulic mobile cranes, material handling equipment like forklifts, road construction machinery such as backhoe loaders, and agricultural equipment including tractors and harvesters. The company serves a wide customer base that includes construction firms, industrial companies, government agencies, and rental businesses, reflecting its broad market penetration. With a sales and service network of over 100 locations in India, the company also exports its products to more than 37 countries worldwide.

news.title: Action Construction Equipment's board will meet on November 12, 2026, to consider and approve Q2 unaudited financial results. The company's insider trading window remains closed from October 01, 2026, and will reopen on November 16, 2026.
Action Construction Equipment Ltd (ACE) to supply Backhoe Loaders for the Ministry of Defence.
Action Construction Equipment has received an order to supply 74 backhoe loaders to the Defense Ministry.

Action Construction Equipment (ACE) shares rose after securing a major equipment supply contract from the Defence Ministry. The company stated the order reflects its efforts under Make in India and AatmaNirbhar Bharat initiatives. ACE is the world's largest pick and carry cranes manufacturer and a leading construction equipment maker in India.
Action Construction Equipment Ltd schedules analyst meet on Sept 30, 2026. One-on-one meeting with Vallum Capital to occur in Faridabad.

Action Construction stock surged 50% in 6 months; ICICI Direct sets 12M target of ₹1,510, implying 23% upside. ICICI cites growth in crane segment, govt infra spending, and defense/export contributions as key drivers for revenue.
Action Construction posts FY 25-26 revenue Rs 3273.7 cr, PAT Rs 425.4 cr. Firm leads crane market with 63%+ share; JV with KATO boosts heavy cranes.

Action Construction Equipment Ltd held its 32nd AGM on Sep 18, 2026 via VC/OAVM. Key agenda included adopting financial statements, declaring Rs.2/share dividend, and ratifying cost auditor remuneration.
Action Construction Equipment to hold analyst and investor meeting on Sept 11 at 2:30 PM.
Action Construction Equipment Ltd schedules analyst/investor meet on Sep 7, 2026 at 3 PM. The one-on-one meeting with Baroda BNP MF will be held in Palwal, Haryana.
